brief:
The opinion piece in Middle East Eye argues that Israel's secular centrist opposition cannot dislodge Prime Minister Netanyahu without addressing the political role of Palestinian citizens of Israel, according to analysis by Meron Rapoport. The commentary frames Palestinian voter engagement as essential to shifting Israel's political landscape and poses their mobilization as a prerequisite for any meaningful challenge to Netanyahu's hold on power.

The piece characterizes the current election cycle as a critical moment for the Israeli opposition to recognize Palestinian citizens as a political force capable of influencing electoral outcomes.

title: Israeli opposition must engage Palestinian citizens to challenge Netanyahu
